name: sign-off
wording: The operator's right, exercised at a gate, to agree that a handover serves its intent, so the work past that gate may go on: signing off a story's read-back starts the story; signing off a plan sends it to be built, the requirements the operator states there binding the lead and its recommendations the lead's to weigh; signing off a change the operator has asked to review lets it join; signing off release makes the work available to the project's users. Only the operator holds it; anyone else exercises it only where delegated authority grants it, in the operator's place.
reason: The operator: what cratylus delivers assumed one convention, GitHub flow with a branch and a pull request per task, and review of every change whatever its risk; it is generic over a project's conventions, and review follows risk as Ship, Show or Ask.
